input: Find churches holding Vacation Bible School (VBS) in 2025 or 2026 (search "VBS 2026", "VBS 2025" and "vacation bible school" with each town name; small and rural churches too) for kids and teens in West Asheville, North Asheville, Candler, Leicester and Woodfin, NC. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Candler NC vacation bible school 2025 church

candidates.name: West Asheville Baptist Church of Asheville
Starnes Cove Baptist Church of Asheville
candidates.note: West Asheville morning VBS in 2025 and 2026; 2026 served ages 4 through 12th grade.

candidates.name: Erwin Hills Baptist Church of Asheville
candidates.note: Evening VBS June 2–6, 2025; Wonder VBS June 7–10, 2026, on New Leicester Highway.

candidates.name: Lake Hills Church of Candler
candidates.note: Morning VBS June 16–19, 2025, 8:30 a.m.–12:30 p.m.; also held VBS in 2026.

candidates.name: Pole Creek Baptist Church of Candler
candidates.note: Official registration lists VBS for kindergarten through sixth grade, 6–8:30 p.m., under a 2025 title.

candidates.name: Mount Pisgah Academy Seventh-day Adventist Church of Candler
candidates.note: Mountain of Miracles VBS held July 20–23, 2026, 6:30–8:30 p.m.

candidates.name: Newfound Baptist Church of Leicester
candidates.note: Wonder Junction VBS held July 20–25, 2025, 5:45–8:45 p.m.

candidates.name: Georgetown Baptist Church of Leicester

candidates.name: Newbridge Baptist Church of Woodfin
